name: Jesus Is Our Husband
overview: The Scriptures reveal a profound relationship between God and His people, portraying the LORD as a faithful husband who lovingly redeems and betroths His bride forever. Isaiah affirms that the LORD is our Maker and Husband, calling us to rejoice as His chosen and cherished ones (Isaiah 54:1, 5). Hosea further emphasizes God's covenantal commitment, promising to betroth His people in righteousness, lovingkindness, and faithfulness, drawing them close with tender care (Hosea 2:14, 19-20). This divine marriage imagery underscores the intimate, enduring, and gracious bond between Christ and His church, marked by steadfast love and covenant loyalty.
